newsitem.title: USA: NAI Technologies shrs bought by director.
newsitem.headline: NAI Technologies shrs bought by director.

text.p: NAI Technologies Inc said Friday that Charles Holmes, director, increased his beneficial holdings by an additional 75,000 shares of common stock, to a total beneficial holding of 3,212,000 shares or 29.04 percent of the shares outstanding.
The company said the holdings consist of 1,175,000 shares of common stock and warrants to purchase 2,037,000 shares of common stock.
The share purchases were made between January 6, 1997 and February 28, 1997 and ranged in price between $3.51 per share and $4.25 per share, the company said.

The purchases of warrants exercisable into a total of 30,000 shares of common stock were made at prices ranging between $1.75 per share and $2.51 per share, between December 26, 1996 and February 27, 1997, the company said.
